description: Simple persistent blob storage for scripts. Data is stored in the `%USERPROFILE%\.lje\data` folder. The namespace is flat: entry names may only contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (max 128 characters) — no subdirectories or file extensions.

functions.name: write
functions.description: Writes a binary blob to the data folder under the given name. Creates the folder if it does not exist. Returns `true` on success, `false` on failure. Progress is always printed to the console.
functions.note: Don't use file extensions, they are purposely omitted for security.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the data entry to write.

params.name: data
params.description: The raw data to store. May contain binary content.

returns.description: `true` if the write succeeded, `false` if it failed.

functions.name: read
functions.description: Reads a previously written blob from the data folder. Returns nothing if the folder does not exist or if the entry is not found.
functions.note: Don't use file extensions, they are purposely omitted for security.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the data entry to read.

returns.description: The stored data as a raw string, or `nil` if not found.
